answer: SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(l.date,1,4)='1997' THEN l.amount END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(l.date,1,4)='1996' THEN l.amount END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(l.date,1,4)='1996' THEN l.amount END) AS growth_pct FROM loan l WHERE substr(l.date,1,4) IN ('1996','1997') AND l.account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp d JOIN client c ON c.client_id=d.client_id WHERE d.type='OWNER' AND c.gender='M')

SELECT ROUND(1.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp d JOIN client c ON c.client_id=d.client_id WHERE d.type='OWNER' AND c.birth_date<'1950-01-01'))/(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) FROM disp d JOIN client c ON c.client_id=d.client_id WHERE d.type='OWNER' AND c.birth_date<'1950-01-01'),2)

WITH t AS (SELECT district_id,A2,A16 FROM district WHERE A3='central Bohemia' ORDER BY A4 DESC, A2 LIMIT 3) SELECT A2 AS district, A16 AS crimes_1996, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(A16),2) FROM t) AS avg_three, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(A16),2) FROM district) AS avg_all, ROUND((SELECT AVG(A16) FROM t)-(SELECT AVG(A16) FROM district),2) AS difference FROM t ORDER BY (SELECT A4 FROM district x WHERE x.district_id=t.district_id) DESC

WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT cd.type, c.district_id FROM card cd JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id=cd.disp_id JOIN client c ON c.client_id=d.client_id) SELECT h.type AS card_type, dd.A2 AS district, dd.A4 AS inhabitants FROM h JOIN district dd ON dd.district_id=h.district_id WHERE dd.A4=(SELECT MIN(d2.A4) FROM h h2 JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id=h2.district_id WHERE h2.type=h.type) ORDER BY h.type, dd.A2

WITH a AS (
  SELECT ac.account_id, ac.district_id,
    (SELECT t.balance FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = ac.account_id AND t.date <= '1996-12-31' ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS bal
  FROM account ac
  WHERE ac.date >= '1996-01-01' AND ac.date <= '1996-12-31'
    AND ac.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = (SELECT A3 FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'))
), per AS (
  SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_1996, ROUND(AVG(a.bal), 2) AS avg_balance
  FROM a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id
)
SELECT district_name, accounts_opened_1996, avg_balance,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(bal), 2) FROM a) AS region_avg_balance,
  (SELECT district_name FROM per ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name LIMIT 1) AS top_district
FROM per ORDER BY district_name

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN k_symbol='UROK' THEN amount WHEN k_symbol='SANKC. UROK' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_interest FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id=2823) AND date>='1998-01-01' AND date<='1998-12-31'

WITH oc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.client_id, o.account_id
  FROM disp o
  WHERE o.type = 'OWNER'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp d2 JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d2.disp_id
                WHERE d2.client_id = o.client_id AND cd.type = 'classic')
), pay AS (
  SELECT oc.client_id, a.district_id, t.bank, t.account AS acct, t.amount
  FROM oc JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = oc.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
)
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oc.client_id) FROM oc JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id) AS clients,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.bank || '|' || p.acct) FROM pay p WHERE p.district_id = d.district_id AND p.bank IS NOT NULL AND p.bank <> '' AND p.acct IS NOT NULL) AS external_accounts,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM pay p WHERE p.district_id = d.district_id), 0) AS total_amount
FROM district d
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, d.A2
SELECT ROUND(AVG(A11),2) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A11 FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id=c.district_id WHERE c.gender='F' AND c.birth_date<'1950-01-01')

SELECT cohort, CAST(ROUND(AVG(A11)) AS INTEGER) AS avg_salary FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.birth_date>='1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END AS cohort, d.district_id, d.A11 FROM client c JOIN disp p ON p.client_id=c.client_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id=p.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id=a.district_id WHERE c.birth_date>='1980-01-01' OR c.birth_date<'1920-01-01') GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY cohort='old'
